name: PD 384 was established by Ordinance No. 21699, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 9,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 384 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 384 was established by Ordinance No. 21699, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 9, 1993. Ordinance No. 21699 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 21699 was amended by Ordinance No. 21872, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 27, 1993. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21699; 21872; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 384 is established on property generally located on the north line of Forest Lane, east of Forest Lake Lane. The size of PD 384 is approximately 7.234 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) The definitions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) All references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) Section 51A-2.101, “Interpretations,” applies to this article.

(d) For purposes of determining the applicability of regulations in this article and in Chapter 51A triggered by adjacency or proximity to another zoning district, and for purposes of interpreting the DIR and RAR requirements of Division 51A-4.800, this district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 384A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan that complies with the requirements of Section 51A-4.702 must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit on the Property. Development and use of the Property must comply with the approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. -- Single family.

(b) Transportation uses.

-- Private street or alley.

(c) Utility and public service uses.

-- Local utilities. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) All yards. An enclosed structure containing a parking space must be setback at least 15 feet from a right-of-way if the space can be entered directly from that right-of-way.

(b) Front yard. Front yards are as shown on the conceptual plan.

(c) Side yard. No minimum side yard.

(d) Rear yard. Minimum rear yard is 10 feet.

(e) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(f) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(g) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(h) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent for residential structures.

(i) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 6,000 square feet.

(j) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two.

(k) Main structure setback. No main structure may be located within eight feet of another main structure.

(l) Number of dwelling units. Maximum number of dwelling units permitted on the Property is 22. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 21872; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Required off-street parking and loading must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51A and reflected on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.111. LANDSCAPING.

A landscape plan must be submitted with the development plan and approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit on the Property. All landscaping must be provided as shown on that plan and, except as otherwise provided, completed in accordance with the provisions contained in Article X. Landscaping and irrigation located in the area north of the required screening wall along the south right-of-way line of Greenwich Lane must be installed concurrent with the construction of the wall. All plant material located in common areas must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.112. SCREENING.

A brick screening wall must be constructed and maintained along the south right-of-way line of Greenwich Lane. Columns may be spaced no more than 30 feet on center. A screening fence, which may not be constructed of chain link and slats, must be constructed and maintained along the east lot line of Lot 14. Both the screening wall and the screening fence must be constructed prior to the issuance of any building permit for the construction of a residence. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Controlled Access Points
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.113. CONTROLLED ACCESS POINTS.

A controlled access point must be provided at each entrance to the Property. The controlled access point located on Greenwich Lane must be limited to use by residents only, and may not be utilized prior to the occupancy of at least one residence. Construction traffic must access the Property to and from Forest Lane whenever physically possible. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.114. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.115. HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION.

Prior to final plat approval, the owner(s) of the Property must execute an instrument creating a homeowners’ association for the purpose of proper care and maintenance of the common areas, private streets, and other functions deemed appropriate. This instrument must be submitted to and approved by the city attorney as to form and by the city plan commission as to its suitability, and filed in the deed records of Dallas County, Texas. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.116. MAINTENANCE.

The property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-384.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 384 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. Nos. 21699; 25850)
